newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 21.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Thursday:
- The United States had a trade deficit with China that was larger in September than any held with other countries.
- Agents of the Federal Bureau of Investigation managed to follow a recently arrested agent of the Central Intelligence Agency as he gave state secrets to Russian diplomats in Singapore.
- Only 43 percent of the $8.2-billion budget of New York's school system finds its way to the classrooms.
- The Federal Bureau of Investigation does not think a bomb was the likely cause of the explosion that sent Trans World Airlines Flight 800 crashing into the ocean.
- International rescue workers have found more than 2,000 lost or abandoned children during the Rwandan refugee exodus.
